steps.clue: Look for the large building where travelers gather, featuring an open, round patch of ground right in its center.
Look toward the tall structures where leaves shade a central open area, and a bright banner flutters above the highest points.
A cluster of large, connected structures stands before you, their combined mass dominating this stretch of walkway.
Where weathered brick meets an open ascent, look for the circular path rising above the ground level.
Near the curb, a small metal object hangs beside a posted message. Hear the chime if your experience was pleasant.
Look for the ground-level entrance beside the building section marked with the letter B. A wide, open space is visible just inside.
A large expanse of green grass stretches out before you, marked by tall, upright frames at either end.
Where metal swings sway beneath open sky, look for the structure just beyond the green expanse.
Look for the tall, pointed structures in the distance, where green canopies shade a central open area.
Look for the low boundary of stacked grey stones, where a dark metal opening stands before a bright structure.
